```{r}
list_datasets = list(
  "cdlinks-baseline" = readxl::read_xlsx("data/CDLINKS baseline aggregated.xlsx"),
  "engage-baseline" = readxl::read_xlsx("data/ENGAGE baseline aggregated.xlsx"),
  "ecemf-baseline" = readxl::read_xlsx("data/ECEMF baseline aggregated.xlsx"),
  "cdlinks-policy" = readxl::read_xlsx("data/CDLINKS policy aggregated.xlsx"),
  "engage-policy" = readxl::read_xlsx("data/ENGAGE policy aggregated.xlsx"),
  "ecemf-policy" = readxl::read_xlsx("data/ECEMF policy aggregated.xlsx")
  )
```


```{r}
for (i_dataset in 1:length(list_datasets)) {
  
  dataset = list_datasets[[i_dataset]]
  
  # carriers present in THIS dataset
  vec_carriers_ds <- dataset %>%
    dplyr::pull(Carrier) %>%
    as.character() %>%
    trimws() %>%
    unique() %>%
    sort()
  
  for (carrier in vec_carriers_ds) {
    
    dataset_carrier = dataset |>
      filter(trimws(as.character(Carrier)) == carrier)

    plt <- ggplot(dataset_carrier) +
      geom_histogram(aes(x = `2050`)) +
      labs(title = paste(names(list_datasets)[i_dataset], "-", carrier))
  
    print(plt)
  }
}
```




```{r}
for (i_dataset in 1:length(list_datasets)) {
  name_dataset = names(list_datasets)[i_dataset]
  list_datasets[[i_dataset]] = 
    list_datasets[[i_dataset]] |>
    mutate(name_dataset = name_dataset)
}

standardize_column_names <- function(dataset) {
  dataset |>
    rename_with(tolower) |>
    rename_with(trimws)
}

list_datasets <- lapply(
  list_datasets,
  standardize_column_names
)

merged_dataset = bind_rows(list_datasets)


colnames(merged_dataset)
```


```{r}
fit_beta_group <- function(data) {
  x <- as.numeric(data[["2050"]])
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]

  n <- length(x)

  if (n == 0L) {
    return(data.frame(
      n_observations = 0L,
      minimum = NA_real_,
      maximum = NA_real_,
      shape1 = NA_real_,
      shape2 = NA_real_,
      fit_success = FALSE
    ))
  }

  minimum <- min(x)
  maximum <- max(x)

  # A Beta distribution cannot be fitted to a constant sample.
  if (n < 2L || minimum == maximum) {
    return(data.frame(
      n_observations = n,
      minimum = minimum,
      maximum = maximum,
      shape1 = NA_real_,
      shape2 = NA_real_,
      fit_success = FALSE
    ))
  }

  # Rescale observations to [0, 1].
  x_scaled <- (x - minimum) / (maximum - minimum)

  # Move observations slightly away from exactly 0 and 1.
  x_scaled <- (x_scaled * (n - 1) + 0.5) / n

  fit <- tryCatch(
    fitdistrplus::fitdist(x_scaled, distr = "beta"),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(fit)) {
    return(data.frame(
      n_observations = n,
      minimum = minimum,
      maximum = maximum,
      shape1 = NA_real_,
      shape2 = NA_real_,
      fit_success = FALSE
    ))
  }

  data.frame(
    n_observations = n,
    minimum = minimum,
    maximum = maximum,
    shape1 = unname(fit$estimate[["shape1"]]),
    shape2 = unname(fit$estimate[["shape2"]]),
    fit_success = TRUE
  )
}

groups <- split(
  merged_dataset,
  list(
    merged_dataset$carrier,
    merged_dataset$name_dataset
  ),
  drop = TRUE
)

beta_fits_list <- lapply(
  groups,
  function(group_data) {
    result <- fit_beta_group(group_data)

    result$carrier <- group_data$carrier[1L]
    result$name_dataset <- group_data$name_dataset[1L]

    result
  }
)

beta_fits <- bind_rows(beta_fits_list)

rownames(beta_fits) <- NULL
```



```{r}
# Keep only successful, finite, positive parameter estimates
valid_fits <- beta_fits[
  is.finite(beta_fits$shape1) &
    is.finite(beta_fits$shape2) &
    beta_fits$shape1 > 0 &
    beta_fits$shape2 > 0,
]

# Identifier for each fitted distribution
valid_fits$distribution <- paste(
  valid_fits$carrier,
  valid_fits$name_dataset,
  sep = " - "
)

# Avoid evaluating exactly at 0 and 1 because the density can be infinite
# at a boundary when shape1 < 1 or shape2 < 1.
x_grid <- seq(1e-2, 1 - 1e-2, length.out = 1000L)

density_list <- lapply(
  seq_len(nrow(valid_fits)),
  function(i) {
    data.frame(
      x = x_grid,
      density = dbeta(
        x_grid,
        shape1 = valid_fits$shape1[i],
        shape2 = valid_fits$shape2[i]
      ),
      carrier = valid_fits$carrier[i],
      name_dataset = valid_fits$name_dataset[i],
      distribution = valid_fits$distribution[i]
    )
  }
)

beta_density_data <- do.call(rbind, density_list)
rownames(beta_density_data) <- NULL


# Plot =================================

ggplot(
  beta_density_data,
  aes(
    x = x,
    y = density,
    colour = distribution,
    group = distribution
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.8) +
  # scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 4)) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Fitted Beta distributions",
    x = "Value on the [0,1] scale",
    y = "Density",
    colour = "Carrier and dataset"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  guides(colour = "none")
```


```{r}
# On this plot, there is one point per dataset and per carrier
# representing the fitted values of the parameters (shape1, shape2)
ggplot(beta_fits) +
  geom_point(aes(x = shape1, y = shape2))

ggplot(beta_fits) +
  geom_point(aes(x = minimum, y = maximum)) +
  scale_x_log10() + scale_y_log10()
```

summary(beta_fits[, c("n_observations", "shape1", "shape2", "fit_success")])
